$comment: The source of sf-quantity's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/quantity (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

change.$comment: Sent on the host as `change` with a detail: once per commit (Enter, leaving the box, a stepper press or a held run, a key) and for a reset to the inherited value (§17.3).

input.$comment: Sent on the host as `input` with a detail each time the number moves; the text box's own input and change stop at the host.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

x-summary: A number field with «−» and «+»: a WAI-ARIA spinbutton with bounds, a step and digits, strict typing in the page's language, ArrowUp/ArrowDown, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End, a held stepper repeats; label, help, error, required, disabled, read-only, the three field sizes and the inherited value as every field has them.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)

forbidden_client_responsibilities: validation beyond the bounds, the step and the digits

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-quantity for a form value that is a number a person adjusts by steps -- an amount, a count, an integer property -- with bounds and digits.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for a range picked by dragging: that is sf-range-slider
Do not read the box's text as the value: read value (a number or null) or the submitted form value

x-decisions: number-type: page-step and precision are numbers with nullable (no number = the default: ten steps, the step's digits); precision is an integer 0..20, as the code clamps.

trait-words: the field-inherit@1 words stay in lang x-trait-words beside the component words, as the sf-switch pilot keeps them; the running words are helpers/inherited-value.js INHERITED_TEXT until the trait has its own folder (Annex A item 13 is open).

trait field-inherit@1: host state data-inherited (§5.3, §20.2) and the trait event sf-field-reset with sf-field:reset as its dated same-detail alias (aliases.json), as the sf-switch pilot; an inherited value never satisfies required (§20.2).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (count 2 of 0..99) plus a price with two digits, a bound reached, invalid with a message, disabled, read-only, inherited and size 2.
css-variables: the nine public variables of public-variables.v1.json plus --sf-quantity-invalid-border-color for the invalid state: ten (§6).
host-states: data-at-min and data-at-max say on the host that the value stands at a bound (§5.3, simai/ui-source#46 item 4), beside the trait's data-inherited.

events: input and change keep their native names and carry a detail {value, text, name, source}; the manifest says carries native (the DOM name) and x-detail (the fields), since a declared carries object would derive sf-quantity-input (§8).

actions: clear, step-up, step-down and the new set-error {message} answer an outcome (§4.4: chaining is not part of the interface; they returned the element). set-error now also sets custom-error, so the form does not submit over it (§17.2; it used to paint only, stand 15 A2).
form.validity: value-missing from the box, range-underflow, range-overflow and step-mismatch read off the value (a person may type past a bound until the commit clamps it), and custom-error.
form: the host submits the number with a point through ElementInternals; the hidden input is not drawn then and the box has no name (§17.1 items 2, 6).
focus: the pointer-focus class is no longer written by the element; the ring follows :focus-visible (§5.3, §16 item 9). The class component's binder still writes it for hand-written markup.
words: decrement and increment are lang runtime words (settings default-from them); range-underflow, range-overflow and step-mismatch are new runtime words for the validity message.
version 1.1.0: set-error and the host states are added members, error is renamed behind a dated alias (§4.10).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.
